  f.sale_date,
  w.fulfilment_type,
  f.net_amount
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON f.receipt_id = w.web_order_id
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  w.fulfilment_type,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as orders
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON f.receipt_id = w.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type

WITH web_sales_by_fulfilment AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    w.fulfilment_type,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON f.receipt_id = w.web_order_id
  LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (6, 7, 8)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period as period,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
    SUM(net_sales),
    2
  ) as click_and_collect_share_pct
FROM web_sales_by_fulfilment
GROUP BY fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period
